name: Texture scroll
description: Scrolls one of the track's textures (water, lava). Placement does not matter. MSR 'Texture scroll'.

fields.name: texture
fields.description: index into the track's texture list (clamped to it); the Inspector lists them with their pictures

fields.name: uSpeed
fields.description: 1/32 texel per quarter tick: about 0.47 texels a second per unit; negative the other way
